summary: Comprehensive testing of PIN authentication feature for Taxi WebToApp. All backend endpoints (16/16 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly. PIN entry, setup, reset, and admin blocked devices features all functional.

issues: WebSocket connection warning in console (non-blocking) - WebSocket closes before connection established during rapid navigation

backend_pin_auth: POST /api/auth/login-pin - wrong PIN returns WRONG_PIN:N error with attempts left
POST /api/auth/set-pin - sets PIN successfully with valid token
POST /api/auth/set-pin - rejects invalid PIN format (not 4 digits)
GET /api/admin/stats - returns stats including blocked_devices count
frontend_pin_screen: Number pad 1-9, 0, delete buttons all present and clickable
Correct PIN (1234) auto-submits and redirects to /customer
Wrong PIN shows error 'Неверный код. Осталось попыток: N'
PIN cleared after wrong entry for retry
frontend_pin_setup: Back button ('Ввести другой код') appears in step 2
frontend_pin_reset: Phone number shown in reset flow
Cancel button returns to PIN entry
frontend_switch_account: 'Другой аккаунт' button clears localStorage PIN data
Redirects to role select page after clearing
admin_panel: Admin login works with admin@taxi.local / admin123
Blocked devices page shows 'Заблокированные устройства' title
Empty state message when no blocked devices
All admin tabs present: Обзор, Карта, Пассажиры, Водители, Заказы, Устройства, Логи, Уведомления, Настройки

critical_code_review_comments: PIN hash uses bcrypt which is secure
PIN lockout after 5 failed attempts is implemented correctly
Device blocking mechanism works as expected
SMS/Push notifications are MOCKED - codes stored in MongoDB verification_codes collection
seed_data_creation: Test user +79009999999 with PIN 1234 already exists in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIN authentication feature fully tested and working. Test user +79009999999 has PIN 1234 set. PIN attempts counter may be non-zero from testing - can be reset by successful login. SMS/Push notifications are MOCKED - verification codes are stored in MongoDB verification_codes collection, not actually sent.
